SELECT: ROUND((first_season_rating - last_season_rating) / first_season_rating * 100, 2) AS decline_rate_pct (评分衰退率)
FROM: episodes e (剧集关联表, 别名e)
titles ep (剧集标题表, 别名ep)

JOIN.description: 剧集 → 剧集标题(获取评分)

WHERE: ep.average_rating IS NOT NULL (剧集评分非空)
e.season_number IS NOT NULL (季号非空)
GROUP_BY: s.id, s.primary_title, e.season_number (按系列和季分组计算各季平均评分)
HAVING: COUNT(DISTINCT e.season_number) >= 3 (至少3季，保证衰退分析有意义)
